title: Today's Plan
can_do: 主动问“今天做什么、几点、接下来呢”，把一天的安排问清楚。

conversation_move.label: ask what happens when in a day

trigger: The day's plan has not been announced yet, so Child asks for the order and the times.
setting: A weekday morning at the breakfast table.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Mom, what are we doing today?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: We have music class, then the market.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What time is my music class?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Home for lunch and a big nap.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then can we paint in the afternoon?

turns.speaker: mom
turns.line: Yes, if the table is tidy first.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I'll tidy it fast, so we can paint.

replay_cards.title: The Saturday morning
replay_cards.setting: Saturday breakfast with no plan announced.
replay_cards.change: Child wants to know the whole day.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks what happens first, what time, and adds one idea of his own for the afternoon.

replay_cards.title: The after-school change
replay_cards.setting: Teacher says Grandpa picks up Child today instead of Dad.
replay_cards.change: Child wants to check the plan at home.
replay_cards.challenge: Child asks Mom what time Grandpa comes and what happens after pickup, and adds his own request for the car ride.

parent_support: 早晨别一次性报完计划，等孩子问一句答一句。
孩子问“几点”时给真实时间，并联系生活：“十点，就是吃完早饭那会儿。”
他的提议可行就采纳，让他体验“问清楚安排”的好处。
